Policy rate has been increased by 0.25 percentage point to 6.75%

2026-09-15

At its September 15, 2026 meeting, the Board of the Central Bank of Armenia decided to:

  • Raise the Policy Rate by 25 basis points, setting it at 6.75%
  • Set the Lombard Repo Facility Rate at 8.25%.
  • Set the Deposit Facility Rate at 5.25%.

Read more in the Executive Monetary Policy Statement.

The Press Conference, led by CBA Governor Martin Galstyan, will take place today at 14:00, and will be streamed live on the CBA’s YouTube channel and Facebook page.

The CBA Monetary Policy Report and Transparency Report will be published today at 18:00 օn the CBA website.
